purpose: Map common MoonCat technical tasks to the minimum repo files an agent should load.

notes: Use primaryFiles first and load optionalFiles only when the task needs explanation, provenance, or cross-checking.
This index routes to existing files and does not duplicate endpoint, contract, source, identifier, trait, or membership data.
If a referenced data file marks a category incomplete, preserve that incomplete status.
Use data/task-recipes.json when the task needs a workflow sequence, guardrails, or stop conditions across multiple files.

tasks.description: Check local hashes, origin/revision evidence, freshness, licenses, copy status, and dependent files for important checked-in upstream/reference snapshots.
notes: Run scripts/validate-upstream-snapshots.py; it is zero-network and detects local drift.
Do not treat a local Git addition commit as an upstream revision.
Keep unresolved origins, dates, licenses, and exact upstream commits explicit.

tasks.description: Find workflow sequences, guardrails, and stop conditions for common MoonCat KB tasks.
notes: Use recipes for sequencing existing files, not as a replacement for the underlying data files.
Recipes do not add endpoint, contract, trait, color, identifier, source, or per-cat facts.

tasks.description: Select or maintain minimal generated context packs for realistic MoonCat coding-agent tasks.
notes: Packs reference minimal local files and guardrails; they do not contain copied source content or full-KB prompts.
Run generator --check and routing validation after changing a route, case, or pack policy.
Preserve each case's required warnings, forbidden claims, and stop conditions rather than guessing unsupported facts.

tasks.description: Find current KB usability gaps, resolved gaps, routing coverage, and recommended next passes.
notes: Use this route for planning, audits, gap review, and next-pass prioritization.
Do not treat gap notes as MoonCat facts; use the referenced data files and sources for technical claims.

tasks.description: Choose the correct MoonCat identifier form and understand conversion limits.
notes: Do not treat rescue indexes, token IDs, OpenSea IDs, and bytes5 catIds as interchangeable.
Use docs only when the JSON summary is not enough to explain a conversion or limitation.

tasks.description: Run representative zero-network identifier conversion, round-trip, formatting, and type-boundary checks.
notes: Run python scripts/validate-identifier-conversions.py; it reads registered local references and makes no network calls.
Use exact type names such as rescueOrder, catIdBytes5, acclimatedTokenId, wmcrTokenId, accessoryId, paletteIndex, and ownedAccessoryIndex.
Do not infer WMCR, marketplace, accessory, palette, or local owned-record conversions from numeric coincidence.

tasks.description: Run bounded zero-network parity checks across selected parser, LibMoonCat/trait, and documented materialization paths.
notes: Run generator --check and the parity validator; both use checked-in inputs and make no network calls.
Structural parser fingerprints are not exact SVG, palette, or cross-renderer equivalence proof.
Treat contract serialization, per-cat palette output, and accessory composition as explicit unavailable/deferred layers unless deterministic local inputs are added in a dedicated pass.

tasks.description: Find API paths, methods, accepted identifier forms, params, and response kinds.
notes: Use the endpoint manifest as a routing aid, not a substitute for full OpenAPI schemas.
Check identifier conventions before constructing MoonCat endpoint parameters.

tasks.description: Plan trait lookups and understand current trait data coverage.
notes: Use query-mooncat-population for complete static per-cat lookup/filtering across all 25,440 rows.
Retain the 64-row sample only as a lightweight representative fixture; live API/ownership/accessory/market state remains outside the generated population.

tasks.description: Look up or filter the complete generated 25,440-MoonCat population while preserving source trust, naming freshness, and excluded live-state boundaries.
notes: Use scripts/query-mooncats.py for exact catId/rescueOrder lookup and multi-field filters without loading raw sources or every shard into agent context.
Treat color labels as derived display metadata, rescue buckets as canonical-derived, and character categories as community-curated noncanonical classifications.
Finalized names are pinned monotonic enrichment at the manifest revision; provisional/live naming and newer chain state are excluded.
Use the validation report through the manifest for exhaustive mismatch counts; do not silently normalize LibMoonCat/source disagreements.

tasks.description: Regenerate, validate, or interpret the bounded per-cat visual-trait prototype.
notes: The artifact has 64 deterministic representative rows and is not complete population coverage.
Use the generator --check mode and dedicated validator; do not hand-edit rows.
Preserve direct, normalized, derived, and unresolved provenance categories and all mismatch originals.

tasks.description: Apply or review deterministic human-facing MoonCat color labels without changing raw trait fields.
notes: Use derived labels only for search, filtering, and display; preserve hueInt, hueName, pale, and genesis.
Do not turn labels into palette, RGB, rendering, rarity, or canonical on-chain trait claims.
Genesis black and white require their source-backed sentinel fields and are not circular hue values.

tasks.description: Find image-rendering API endpoints and image-related identifier requirements.
notes: Endpoint image response types and query parameters live in data/api-endpoints.json.
Parser, library, or on-chain SVG behavior should be checked through optional context before making implementation claims.

tasks.description: Find known contract entries, contract-derived constants, and source provenance.
notes: Do not invent or fill missing contract addresses.
Use sources.json before relying on non-obvious contract claims.

tasks.description: Find reviewed MoonCatRescue architecture decisions and distinguish stated design intent from implementation or current-state evidence.
notes: Use the decision index for the complete pinned dev-environment ADR directory; do not infer current-master freshness or future numbering from the snapshot.
An ADR records design intent and stated consequences, not current deployment, live state, or implementation completion.
Load parser, contract, generated-artifact, or current-state evidence separately when a claim requires it.

tasks.description: Find curated sourceRefs, trust notes, and reference handling policy.
notes: Add or update source entries only in a source-focused pass.
If sources conflict, document the conflict instead of choosing silently.

tasks.description: Review trait-data strategy, observed upstream shape, and promotion limits.
notes: This task intentionally loads the Markdown strategy because curated machine-readable trait data is incomplete.
Avoid promoting full upstream mappings without a separate documented import and validation pass.

tasks.description: Find community-curated character-cat definitions, exact memberships, and related hue notes.
notes: Character-cat data is community-curated; preserve trust and coverage notes from the referenced files.
Use the index file for exact membership numbers rather than copying lists into prompts.

tasks.description: Find rescue/history bucket membership arrays and related identifier conventions.
notes: Use the bucket file for existing membership arrays.
Confirm index kind before mixing bucket memberships with API parameters or token-facing identifiers.

tasks.description: Review original browser-side normal MoonCat rescue/mining seed search, the wallet-free snippet, and the embeddable widget example.
notes: Use this route for searchSeed, seed candidate generation, keccak valid-hash checks, catId derivation, and rescueCat transaction-boundary context.
The snippet and widget are wallet-free and network-free; do not add private-key, provider, account, gas, or transaction-submission code.
The widget renders found catIds with mooncatparser.js, but do not infer traits, ownership, rescue-order membership, current availability, or chain state from rescue mining alone.

tasks.description: Find exact MoonCatAccessories definition, management, eligibility, assignment, ownership, wear-state, verification, and identifier semantics.
notes: Keep definition management by wallet separate from accessory ownership by rescue order and Acclimated ERC-721 action authorization.
Do not treat accessoryId, ownedAccessoryIndex, paletteIndex, zIndex, rescueOrder, bytes5 catId, or wrapper token IDs as interchangeable.
The review records source capabilities only; do not infer current definitions, ownership, supply, approval, eligibility, or administration.

tasks.description: Start with the thin MoonCat accessory-system overview, then follow the separate lifecycle and rendering reviews for exact behavior, identifier boundaries, and evidence limits.
notes: Use the overview first for broad definition-to-rendering questions; load the two detailed reviews only when exact contract behavior is needed.
Keep definition management, rescue-order ownership, wear settings, verification filtering, and rendering consumption as separate responsibilities.
Do not treat accessoryId, ownedAccessoryIndex, paletteIndex, zIndex, rescueOrder, bytes5 catId, or wrapper token IDs as interchangeable.
The integration is static source evidence only; do not infer current ownership, wear, verification, availability, prices, supply, or exact generated output.

tasks.description: Find top-level MoonCat categories, special-category scaffolds, and color/hue context.
notes: Respect incomplete category markers.
Use character-cat and hue files only when the classification task needs those narrower datasets.

tasks.description: Find hue/coating scaffolds, character hue notes, and color-comparison method context.
notes: Use data/color-source-inventory.json before changing canonical color/hue data or claiming rendering behavior.
Do not infer exact trait mappings from hue notes unless the referenced file explicitly provides them.
Use docs/color-math.md only when method explanation is needed.

tasks.description: Trace a reviewed ChainStation Web behavior from route or UI surface through selected local data, helper, API, wallet, renderer, or configuration evidence without treating the pinned source as live state.
notes: Use the selected surface's evidence paths and source/config/runtime classification before following an implementation flow.
Load ADR intent separately when relevant; an ADR and a pinned application source file answer different questions.
Do not infer current deployment, live API/chain state, ownership, marketplace status, asset availability, or secrets from this audit.

tasks.description: Find curated CID placeholders, project links, and preserved navigation links.
notes: Do not promote preserved navigation links into canonical sources without a source-focused review.
Use data/project-links.json trustLevel, ownershipStatus, and trustNotes for classified links; use data/link-index.json for broader preserved research links.
Leave unknown CIDs or URLs incomplete rather than guessing.

tasks.description: Trace a bounded Genesis MoonCat history question from contract formula and release groups through released rescue-order membership and the March 2021 historical evidence.
notes: Keep contract-derived IDs, released membership, historical vote accounts, and live/current state as separate evidence classes.
Use the six released groups for exact mapping; do not turn the remaining 160 derivable indices into claimed tokens, rescue-order entries, adoptions, or owners.
The official outcome supports permanent locking, while the technical locking mechanism remains unresolved without direct post-vote evidence.

tasks.description: Look up original MoonCat naming semantics, consume CatNamed events safely, or inspect the deterministic historical naming snapshot.
notes: Preserve raw bytes32 values and distinguish decode/display status from original-contract acceptance.
Treat CatNamed history, zero-name events, current catNames storage, display moderation, and the checked-in snapshot as separate evidence layers.
For maintained finalized current-name or history questions, route to use-maintained-name-index rather than presenting data/mooncat-names.json as current.
Use data/api-endpoints.json only for the documented optional /events request surface; it does not prove current API availability, event completeness, ordering, response freshness, or chain state.
Stop for separately authorized live verification when a request needs current storage, ownership, offer state, or live state beyond a reviewed finalized name-index revision.

tasks.description: Choose the reviewed MoonCatDAO name-index finalized artifacts for revision-bounded current-name, history, order/year, namer, or blank-event questions.
notes: Use finalized data/events.jsonl as canonical finalized CatNamed history; finalized current-name artifacts are derived from it.
Use the historical data/mooncat-names.json snapshot only for its deterministic source-comparison boundary, not as the preferred maintained finalized source.
Do not treat pending or *-live artifacts as canonical state, and do not embed them in a canonical population artifact.
A changed finalized nonblank name is an invariant violation requiring investigation; blank events remain in history but do not populate current-name state.
Stop only when a request requires a newer-than-reviewed revision or live state; protocol semantics still route to review-mooncat-naming.

tasks.description: Review or maintain provenance-aware factual MoonCat answer constraints without loading the full KB or confusing them with routing benchmark cases.
notes: Select one factual case, then load only its required domain files; optional files do not authorize broad corpus loading.
The benchmark constrains source-aware correctness and stop conditions; it does not run or score an LLM.
Keep factual retrieval cases separate from data/agent-query-cases.json, which remains a routing/context benchmark.

tasks.description: Find an exact locally extracted ABI artifact for a reviewed contract without guessing unavailable interfaces or collapsing adjacent contracts into the eight-core path.
notes: Follow abiArtifact.path only when abiStatus is exact-local-abi-extracted and verify its recorded hash/provenance.
All eight core contracts and adjacent WMCR have exact local ABI artifacts; CatNamer remains semantic-only without a complete ABI claim.
ABI availability does not establish deployed bytecode equivalence, deployment block, current state, or event-history completeness.

tasks.description: Query exact event signatures, topic0 values, indexed parameters, contract classification, and identifier annotations from local registries.
notes: Use the canonical signature and ordered indexed flags exactly; topic0 is Ethereum Keccak-256, not NIST SHA3-256.
Keep generic ERC events and their token IDs contract-scoped instead of treating every tokenId as rescueOrder.
CatNamed event presence does not imply current name state because an all-zero bytes32 may emit without consuming storage.

tasks.description: Plan a zero-network MoonCat event indexer using exact local event references, safe identifier interpretation, corroborating reads, and explicit start/finality limits.
notes: Recipes are guidance over exact events, not live scanners, databases, event datasets, or complete-history claims.
Use only verified start/deployment fields; unknown deployment blocks remain unknown.
Treat logs as provisional until finality, checkpoint by block plus transactionHash/logIndex identity, and corroborate mutable current state separately.
